programmes.name: Computer and Information Science
programmes.credits: Normally at least 32 Berea course credits across degree; see major requirements
programmes.description: Build software and study how computers represent and process information.
programmes.curriculum: Software design, data structures and algorithms, upper-level design/foundations courses, general education and electives.
programmes.practical: Capstone can be a computing design practicum, an internship, or an approved undergraduate research experience.

programmes.name: Biological Sciences
programmes.credits: Normally at least 32 Berea course credits across degree; see major requirements
programmes.description: Investigate living systems, from cells and genes to organisms and ecosystems.
programmes.curriculum: Four-credit biological sciences core plus six distribution credits; subjects include cellular biology, diversity, genetics, ecology/evolution. General education is additional.
programmes.practical: Field ecology and laboratory-oriented courses appear in the curriculum; a guaranteed external internship is not established.

programmes.name: Art: Studio
programmes.credits: Normally at least 32 Berea course credits across degree; see major requirements
programmes.description: Develop ideas through drawing, colour, print, fibres, sculpture and intermedia.
programmes.curriculum: Four studio foundation courses, portfolio review by fourth term, a medium studied to advanced level, and a capstone; general education is additional.
programmes.practical: Studio practice and a final capstone. The fourth-term portfolio review is during the degree, not a verified pre-admission portfolio requirement.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.duration: Credit-based; 60 units. Time depends on placement and course load; two years is not guaranteed.
programmes.credits: At least 60 US semester units for associate degree; computer science emphasis 23 units
programmes.description: Learn programming, digital systems and data structures before employment or a separate transfer application.
programmes.curriculum: Computer systems, assembly language, digital logic, C programming and calculus, followed by C++ or Java/data-structures options. General education is additional.
programmes.practical: Applied coursework; guaranteed internship not verified. Transfer preparation must match the intended receiving university.
programmes.campus: Santa Monica main campus; check course delivery

programmes.name: Business Administration 2.0
programmes.duration: Credit-based; 60 units. Time depends on placement and course load; two years is not guaranteed.
programmes.credits: 60 US semester units; SMC business emphasis 29 units
programmes.description: Study how organisations account, make decisions and work within markets and law.
programmes.curriculum: Financial and managerial accounting, business law/communication, micro- and macroeconomics, statistics and mathematics; Cal-GETC general education.
programmes.practical: Applied coursework; guaranteed internship not verified. Transfer preparation must match the intended receiving university.
programmes.campus: Santa Monica main campus; check course delivery

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.duration: Credit-based; 60 units. Time depends on placement and course load; two years is not guaranteed.
programmes.credits: 60 US semester units for the degree
programmes.description: Explore cognition, emotion, behaviour and scientific research methods.
programmes.curriculum: Psychology major courses and general education including Cal-GETC; degree requires a minimum overall GPA of 2.0 and C/P in major courses.
programmes.practical: Applied coursework; guaranteed internship not verified. Transfer preparation must match the intended receiving university.
programmes.campus: Santa Monica main campus; check course delivery

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.description: Use mathematics, programming and statistical reasoning to understand data.
programmes.curriculum: 180 ECTS: basic studies, data-science major including thesis/seminar, minor and electives. Topics include mathematics, programming, statistics and machine learning.
programmes.practical: Bachelor thesis and project-oriented study. Guaranteed external internship not verified.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering
programmes.description: Investigate chemical processes, materials and sustainable technologies.
programmes.curriculum: Mathematics and natural sciences with chemical engineering major, minor, electives and bachelor thesis.
programmes.practical: Laboratory and applied study documented; guaranteed placement not verified.

programmes.name: Economics
programmes.qualification: Bachelor of Science (Economics and Business Administration)
programmes.description: Use quantitative tools to study markets, inequality and economic policy.
programmes.curriculum: Basic economics and quantitative methods, mathematics/programming, major, minor, electives, bachelor seminar and thesis.
programmes.practical: Thesis and optional exchange; a guaranteed internship is not established.

programmes.name: Design and Media
programmes.description: Create visual, physical and digital work through art, media and design.
programmes.curriculum: Visual communication, industrial and digital design, collaborative projects, critical thinking and design practice.
programmes.practical: Hands-on collaborative coursework, prototyping and projects.

programmes.name: International Foundation Year — Business, Social Sciences and Humanities
programmes.qualification: International Foundation Year — preparation, not a bachelor degree
programmes.duration: 1.5 or 2 semesters, then a separately funded undergraduate degree
programmes.description: Prepare for a selected Sheffield undergraduate degree through a separate international foundation programme.
programmes.curriculum: Academic English and project skills, then business/management/finance, economics, social sciences/humanities or architecture-related modules depending on the target degree.
programmes.practical: Project-based and academic preparation; no guaranteed internship. Progression requires overall, module and English grades for the chosen degree.
programmes.campus: University of Sheffield International College, Sheffield

programmes.name: International Foundation Year — Science and Engineering
programmes.qualification: International Foundation Year — preparation, not a bachelor degree
programmes.duration: 1.5 or 2 semesters, then a separately funded undergraduate degree
programmes.description: Prepare for a selected Sheffield undergraduate degree through a separate international foundation programme.
programmes.curriculum: Academic English and project skills plus biology/chemistry, chemistry/mathematics or physics/mathematics modules depending on the target degree.
programmes.practical: Project-based and academic preparation; no guaranteed internship. Progression requires overall, module and English grades for the chosen degree.
programmes.campus: University of Sheffield International College, Sheffield

routes.name: International first-year admission
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant educated outside the destination country
routes.eligibility: Meet university-entrance requirements in your own country and submit strong secondary/leaving results, application documents and one accepted test. Admission to the college precedes declaring a major.
routes.recognition: Kazakhstan diploma equivalence is assessed by Berea; entrance eligibility in the awarding country is required. Do not assume a Grade 11 certificate alone satisfies every document rule.
routes.subjects: General secondary preparation. No programme-specific school-subject minimum verified for this international route.

SAT.detail: SAT 980 is one accepted test; ACT, IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo may satisfy the published test step instead.

ACT.detail: ACT composite 19; other accepted tests may satisfy the step.

IELTS.detail: IELTS 6 overall and 5 in each area is one alternative.

TOEFL.detail: TOEFL iBT 68 is one published alternative; confirm handling of the revised TOEFL scale.

ENGLISH.detail: At least one approved test is required. SAT/ACT can satisfy that step instead of a separate English test; not an unconditional no-test route.

tuition.note: Gross tuition schedule not captured. All admitted international students receive the separately described funding package; do not treat unknown gross tuition as zero.

routes.mandatoryFees: International FAQ expects a USD 2,200 enrolment deposit, with additional aid possible for students unable to pay. Other upfront travel/visa expenses need checking.
routes.living: Tuition, housing, food and fees are covered by the international package; personal expenses remain. No independent living estimate verified.
routes.nextAction: Check diploma documentation and choose one accepted test before preparing the international application.
questions: Confirm the November 30 deadline year and timezone for your intake.
Confirm revised TOEFL-score equivalence, all application documents, and continuing aid/work obligations.

routes.name: International F-1 associate / transfer preparation
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant educated outside the destination country
routes.eligibility: Submit school records, passport, financial statement, USD 75 application fee, English evidence and personal essay. Normally age 18; age 16–17 applicants must have completed high school and meet local guardian conditions.
routes.recognition: SMC reviews international records. Confirm your Kazakhstan diploma and any translated documents. An associate degree does not guarantee university transfer or a scholarship.
routes.subjects: No programme-specific secondary-subject threshold verified; mathematics/English placement can affect time to completion.

SAT.detail: SAT is not listed in the checked international document checklist; no explicit exemption statement verified.

IELTS.detail: IELTS 5.0 is one accepted evidence option.

TOEFL.detail: Published TOEFL alternatives include 45 iBT or score 3 on the 1–6 scale; consult the official PDF.

ENGLISH.detail: English proficiency evidence is required for the academic route. Several tests, specified prior education or language-school completions are accepted; waivers are conditional.

tuition.note: 2026/27: per US semester unit, including enrollment fee, non-resident tuition and surcharge. Official 24-unit annual example is USD 11,664; a 60-unit degree plus any transfer costs is additional.

routes.mandatoryFees: 2026/27: health fee USD 28/semester; mandatory insurance USD 2,310/year plus initial USD 196 for new students. Application USD 75. Other listed fees include some optional/waivable items; check the fee schedule.
routes.living: SMC 2026/27 estimate: homestay living USD 13,869 for 9 months, plus personal USD 4,968 and books USD 1,064; total estimated budget USD 34,000 includes tuition/fees. Checked 14 Nov 2026.
routes.nextAction: Ask SMC to confirm your diploma/age eligibility and map courses to one intended transfer university.
questions: Confirm entry-term deadline, international document translations and guardian arrangements if under 18.
Verify destination university transfer requirements, later tuition and aid separately. No full transfer guarantee verified.

routes.name: Foreign school diploma — SAT/ACT round A
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant educated outside the destination country
routes.eligibility: Foreign upper-secondary qualification granting corresponding higher-education eligibility in its awarding country, plus SAT or ACT. Applicants are ranked by test results; minima are eligibility thresholds.
routes.recognition: Foreign qualification must grant higher-education eligibility in the awarding country. Aalto evaluates submitted documents; translate originals into Finnish, Swedish or English. Kazakhstan diploma acceptance is not pre-certified in this catalogue.
routes.subjects: Strong mathematics preparation; programming and quantitative study support this field.

SAT.detail: SAT at least 1350 overall and 700 Mathematics, or ACT at least 29 composite and 30 Mathematics. SAT or ACT required for round A; test completed 1 January 2025 or later. Minima do not guarantee selection.

ACT.detail: SAT at least 1350 overall and 700 Mathematics, or ACT at least 29 composite and 30 Mathematics. Official results must arrive by deadline.

IELTS.detail: This admission round explicitly does not require a language test result.

TOEFL.detail: This admission round explicitly does not require a language test result.

ENGLISH.detail: Sufficient English ability is expected, but a separate language test result is explicitly not required for this route.

tuition.note: Bachelor fee for non-EU/EEA fee-liable students; schedule applies to study rights starting 1 Aug 2025 onward. Master tuition differs and is additional.

routes.mandatoryFees: Normally EUR100 application fee for non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants, subject to exemptions. Student Union and healthcare fees are additional; 2026 healthcare fee EUR36/semester, future fees need checking.
routes.living: Aalto fee page checked 14 Nov 2026 says plan for at least EUR800/month living costs; this is a minimum planning estimate, not tuition or a guaranteed housing price.
routes.nextAction: Confirm your diploma grants higher-education eligibility and schedule SAT or ACT early enough for official result delivery.

routes.eligibility: Age at least 17. Kazakhstan Certificate of Completed Education with grade 3 or 4 in relevant subjects, subject to individual pathway confirmation. Two-semester English threshold is IELTS for UKVI 5.0, writing at least 5.0 and other skills at least 4.0, or equivalent.
routes.recognition: The International College explicitly lists Kazakhstan qualifications. This is foundation admission; progression to the university requires the target degree grades and separate degree fees. It is not direct bachelor entry.

SAT.detail: SAT is not listed in the checked foundation entry criteria; an explicit no-SAT statement was not verified.

TOEFL.detail: Equivalent English evidence is mentioned, but a TOEFL threshold was not verified.

awards.name: Berea international funding package
awards.benefits: Tuition, housing, food and fees for admitted international students. Fall 2027 policy also covers supplies for all enrolled students. Personal expenses and upfront travel are not established as covered.
awards.eligibility: All admitted international students under the published international policy; admission is selective, with no probability estimate.
awards.application: Complete the international admission application and its financial documents; obtain individual deposit/aid instructions with an offer.
awards.renewal: Fall 2027 policy says coverage through graduation. Confirm satisfactory-progress, Work Program and continuing enrolment terms with the aid office.
awards.upfront: USD 2,200 deposit expected before I-20; additional aid may be available if unable to pay. Visa, travel and personal spending still need a plan.
awards.cycle: Fall 2027 onward policy; international FAQ undated

awards.name: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship
awards.benefits: Competitive waiver of the full tuition fee. No living-cost package. Programmes can award no scholarships.
awards.eligibility: Fee-liable non-EU/EEA applicants, selected on the programme evaluation criteria. Eligibility is not an award guarantee.
awards.application: Select scholarship application on the admission form during the application period; later applications are not accepted.
awards.renewal: Normative study period: three years for the bachelor, full-time study according to approved study plan. Master continuation scholarship has additional conditions and is separate.
awards.upfront: Living expenses, study materials, union/healthcare costs, insurance and travel remain. If no waiver, tuition is normally due as one annual instalment.

sources.note: Official FAQ checked live. November 30 is published without a year: no future dated deadline inferred. Test minima are eligibility thresholds. Aid covers tuition/housing/food/fees; deposit and personal expenses remain.

sources.title: Berea Admissions & Aid — fully funded degree from Fall 2027
sources.note: Policy promises tuition, housing, food, fees and supplies for all enrolled students from Fall 2027; international FAQ separately confirms international package. Retention details require review.

sources.note: Berea course credits are not ECTS or US semester credit hours. Most degrees require at least 32 course credits; consult major and general education requirements.

Santa Monica College — international application documents
sources.note: F-1 applicants need financial evidence, passport, transcripts, fee, English evidence and essay. Special age/guardian rules for 16–17-year-olds; SAT not explicitly discussed.

sources.title: SMC Proof of English Proficiency for F-1 Visa Applicants
sources.note: PDF revised 24 March 2026; IELTS 5, TOEFL and multiple other test/education/language-school routes. Not all waivers apply to Kazakhstan schooling.

sources.title: SMC International Student Tuition & Fees — Fall 2026–Summer 2027
sources.note: USD 486 per semester unit includes enrollment/non-resident tuition/surcharge. USD 11,664 assumes 24 units/year, not full two-year degree pace. Separate mandatory insurance, living and other expenses.

sources.title: SMC 2026–2027 Catalog — Transferring from SMC
sources.note: Transfer is a separate application. International/nonresident students may require higher GPA; no named campus or funding guarantee.

Aalto — 2027 admission round A with a high school diploma
sources.note: Foreign secondary qualification must grant corresponding higher-education eligibility at home. SAT/ACT minima vary by study field. Language test not required for these round A programmes. Minima are not selection guarantees.

sources.title: Aalto — Scholarships and Tuition Fees
sources.note: Bachelor fees: business/technology EUR12,000/year; art EUR15,000/year. Excellence Scholarship is full tuition only. 2026 healthcare fee EUR36/semester; future fee not inferred.

sources.title: Aalto — Apply to Bachelor’s programmes in English
sources.note: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants normally pay EUR100 application fee, subject to stated exemptions.

sources.title: Aalto — Design and Media admission 2027
sources.note: Separate art route: preliminary/intake assignments and interview, plus documented English proficiency. Schooling waivers are specific; Kazakhstan English-medium schooling alone is not a published waiver.

University of Sheffield International College — Entry requirements
sources.note: Foundation Kazakhstan row lists Certificate of Completed Education with grade 3 or 4 in relevant subjects. Confirm pathway-specific mapping. Progression requires grades and English standards; university degree is not guaranteed unconditionally.

sources.title: University of Sheffield International College — Fees, accommodation and living costs
sources.note: Two-semester foundation fees used. Degree tuition is additional and not captured. Living financial requirement changes for applications on/after 30 November 2026; do not treat as guaranteed actual living cost.

sources.title: University of Sheffield — Entry requirements for students from Kazakhstan
sources.note: Direct entry criteria include certain A-level/IB/NIS and further-study qualifications. Foundation is a separate route; standard Grade 11 diploma direct entry not asserted.
